video_title: Houston Rockets Postgame: Kevin Durant talks win over Wizards

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant on the importance of controlling game pace
quotes.excerpt: the game is about pace, life is about pace, life is about balance
quotes.quote: The game is about pace, life is about pace, life is about balance. You can't go 100 miles an hour all the time and I think that's what all young players we try to figure out and I'm still trying to figure it out in year 20. You want to go, when to go, when to play with a little bit of pace and I think that it will figure it out over time. I think he's getting better at it too. But when you can just, you're so fast and you're so athletic and you feel like you could be anybody sometimes, you know, the ambition is going to have you playing 100 miles an hour.
quotes.social_post: Kevin Durant on the importance of pace in the NBA: You cannot go 100 miles an hour all the time. I am still trying to figure it out in year 20.

structured.context: Kevin Durant discusses the importance of controlling game pace and balance during his postgame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant on his role as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: I'm a playmaker, brother. I feel like when I step out on the court, hockey assists and regular assists
quotes.quote: I'm a playmaker, brother. I feel like when I step out on the court, hockey assists and regular assists are always going to be on the table, especially with a lot of attention being drawn my way. I mean, we were up 30 points right there and I seen a double team from AD and I got Twinn wide open shot. So I just got to be prepared when those different coverages come and be ready to make those right passes.
quotes.social_post: Kevin Durant on his role as a playmaker: I feel like when I step out on the court, hockey assists and regular assists are always going to be on the table, especially with a lot of attention being drawn my way.

structured.context: Kevin Durant explains his mindset as a playmaker when facing double teams from Anthony Davis.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant on working with young players in the league
quotes.excerpt: worked out with a lot of the young guys in the league, Ace is definitely one of those guys
quotes.quote: I worked out with a lot of the young guys in the league, Ace is definitely one of those guys that I was drawn to when he was in high school. So as many times I just get in the gym with these guys, feel out who they are, it's always been cool. He asked about AJ, I did the same thing with AJ when he was in high school. So I think that's a good way to get back to the younger generation coming into the league, just getting in the gym with one another.
quotes.social_post: Kevin Durant on mentoring young players like Ace and AJ: I worked out with a lot of the young guys in the league. It is always been cool to get in the gym with these guys and feel out who they are.

structured.context: Kevin Durant reflects on his experience working out with young prospects like Ace Bailey and AJ Dybantsa.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant on his motivation to keep playing
quotes.excerpt: just leading by example, just showing up every day
quotes.quote: Just leading by example, just showing up every day. I think that's the easiest job we got in this thing is to show up and see what happens and I think when people see me every day regardless of the circumstance, situations, or regardless of what I've been through, I think that inspires everybody to just do the same, just get up and go to work the next day, no matter what happened the day before.
quotes.social_post: Kevin Durant on his motivation: Leading by example and showing up every day regardless of the circumstances inspires everybody to just do the same and get to work.

structured.context: Kevin Durant speaks about his leadership style and the importance of consistency in his daily work routine.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant on advice for rookie players
quotes.excerpt: just stay with it. It's going to be games like this, it's going to be games when you feel
quotes.quote: Just stay with it. It's going to be games like this, it's going to be games when you feel like you're the best player in the world. It's just all about how you balance it all and how you understand that you in this for the long haul, not just about this year or next year or year after that, you trying to be in this thing for decades, for a couple decades. These games are good for you to learn from and get better from and understand you never want to put yourself in this position again.
quotes.social_post: Kevin Durant on advice for rookies: Stay with it. It is all about how you balance it all and how you understand that you are in this for the long haul, not just this year or next.

structured.context: Kevin Durant offers advice to rookie players about maintaining perspective and focusing on long-term career development.
